name: ⚔️ Lanebreakers: Hero Arena 5v5
description:
A fast 5v5 hero battle arena for phones and PC! Pick a hero, push your lane with your minions, destroy the enemy towers and break their Core.

⚔️ 8 heroes with unique abilities: tanks, mages, archers, assassins and healers
🤖 Play solo right away - bots fill every empty slot
🗺️ 3 lanes, jungle monsters, the Sky Titan and the Treasure Golem
🛒 Buy items with gold every match, or let Auto-Buy do it for you
💎 Earn crystals every match to unlock new heroes and skins
🎁 Daily rewards and a first-win bonus every day
⏱️ Short matches: about 10-15 minutes

Controls: move with the stick or WASD. Your hero attacks automatically. Tap an enemy to focus it. Q / E / R for abilities, B to recall, P for the shop.
